Nina Shah: Noticed 3 invoices got post-facto corrections this morning. Token ingestion for a few customers arrived late leading to credits. Need owners for RCA + customer comms.

Evan Brooks: Which customers and window? I can take the pipeline side.

Nina Shah: Customers: dataforge, quickpay, insightx. Delay window ~2026-05-06 03:50-04:10 UTC. Adjustments: ADJ-9155, ADJ-9156, ADJ-9157. Artifacts: s3://redwood-metering/incidents/2026-05-06/manifest.csv

Sofia Kim: I'll own the billing corrections + outreach. Draft line: "We identified delayed processing of usage events; we've corrected counts and applied adjustments ADJ-9155/9156/9157. We're implementing monitoring to reduce recurrence."

billing-bot: Adjustments queued: ADJ-9155 ADJ-9156 ADJ-9157 status=pending

Evan Brooks: Quick triage: consumer lag spikes on collector group during broker GC window. Logs snippet from collector-1:
```
2026-05-06T03:48:59Z WARN consumer Heartbeat timed out, sending leaveGroup
2026-05-06T03:49:02Z ERROR consumer Rebalance timeout for group=collector-main
```
Short mitigation: increase `session.timeout.ms` and enable cooperative rebalancing. I'll test in staging and open PR.

Nina Shah: Can we also add an alert for delayed processed_at > ingested_at by >5m? Route to #eng-infra and notify oncall.

Evan Brooks: Agree. I'll add `MeteringIngestDelay` alert: expr `sum(increase(metering_events_delayed[5m]))>0` for 3m.

Sofia Kim: Timeline proposal: Evan RCA + config PR by 2026-05-12, Evan alerts by 2026-05-09, Sofia to send customer emails and finalize adj by 2026-05-08, postmortem doc by 2026-05-15.

billing-bot: Adjustment processed: ADJ-9155 status=completed 2026-05-06T12:04:22Z

Nina Shah: Please attach SQL used for recurrence scan to the postmortem ticket PM-828. Suggested SQL: `SELECT count(*) FROM metering.events WHERE processed_at - ingested_at > interval '5 minutes' AND ingested_at > now() - interval '90 days'`

Evan Brooks: Found two similar incidents in the last 60 days coinciding with broker maintenance windows. Will include that in RCA.

Sofia Kim: I'll send the first batch of customer emails now and post the template to /docs/billing/delayed-ingest-template.md. Updating PM-828 with S3 link.

Nina Shah: Good. Keep thread updated with PR links and any customer replies. We'll monitor next two invoice cycles for recurrence.
